results.title: Why even a strong El Niño does not guarantee a poor Indian monsoon
results.content: Seven Indian monsoons since 1950 have run into a moderate or strong El Niño. Of these, in five years, including 2026, monsoon rainfall levels were at least 10% lower than the long-term average. The IMD refers to this level as 'deficient’. The 2023 season was something of an exception with ‘below average’ rainfall. However, 1997 had ‘average’ rainfall

results.title: Can we deny caste on campus?
results.content: Caste discrimination in India’s higher education institutions is a pervasive, systemic issue. Experts say sensitising faculty and students along with providing remedial support for students from marginalised communities is essential to address this issue. They also called for conducting independent inquiry into deaths of SC/ST students in India’s premier institutions.
